title: quick accent has a display issue in dual-screen mode
author: CaiZiYuan2019

judgment.rationale: The report describes a plausible Quick Accent multi-monitor positioning and sizing defect, but it was filed against PowerToys 0.97.2 and the latest maintainer request is to update and retest. A merged Quick Accent fix already changed monitor-DPI, popup-width, and positioning behavior for the cited class of problems, so a new design would be speculative until the reporter confirms whether the current release still reproduces it.
evidence: The reporter used PowerToys 0.97.2 via auto-update and reports a Quick Accent candidate box extending beyond both displays in a horizontal 2560x1440 plus vertical 2160x3840 setup.
The report includes a screenshot and a second screenshot showing the monitor arrangement, but no bug report ZIP or numbered reproduction sequence beyond invoking Quick Accent.
The automated triage comment identifies similar historical Quick Accent positioning issues 40498 and 49489 and requests concrete reproduction details plus confirmation on the latest stable release.
Collaborator daverayment explicitly asked the reporter to update and retest because positioning and sizing were addressed in recent versions, and applied /needinfo.

Merged PR 46593 (https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/46593) covers the cited class of Quick Accent display failures, including raw monitor DPI, logical popup width, multi-monitor positioning, and off-screen overflow; it merged on 2026-05-19.
The issue remains open with Needs-Author-Feedback and has no linked open fix attempt or assignee.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to retest on the latest stable PowerToys release and state whether the same dual-monitor layout still reproduces the overflow.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR 46593 is a concrete public fix attempt covering Quick Accent monitor-DPI conversion, popup width limits, and positioning for multi-monitor and differently scaled displays. Issue 50752 was reported on an older 0.97.2 build, so it is not appropriate to propose competing code changes until a current-release retest shows that the merged path is still insufficient.

coverage.detail: Merged Quick Accent UI fix for display DPI, popup width, positioning, and related selection-window behavior.
Prior multi-monitor/aspect-ratio positioning report whose targeted fix was included in PR 46593.
Related Quick Accent selection-window sizing/repositioning report with a mitigation already applied.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent overflowed beyond the usable area of a horizontal 2560x1440 display and a vertical 2160x3840 display on PowerToys 0.97.2. The report is consistent with older Quick Accent DPI and popup-sizing failures, but the maintainer points out that those paths were addressed in newer releases and asks for a retest.
known_information: The affected module is Quick Accent.
The reported version is PowerToys 0.97.2 installed by auto-update.
The display arrangement is one horizontal 2560x1440 monitor and one vertical 2160x3840 monitor.
The candidate box extends beyond the visible display range on both screens according to the report and screenshot.
The issue has Issue-Bug, Needs-Author-Feedback, and Product-Quick Accent labels.
A collaborator requested an update and retest on a current release in comment https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50752#issuecomment-5801598746.
Merged PR 46593 changed Quick Accent's monitor-DPI calculation, logical width limit, and display positioning, and its description explicitly covers issues 35094 and 40498.
inferences: The original symptom may have been caused by the pre-PR-46593 DPI or popup-width/positioning path, but the current discussion does not establish that it still exists after updating.

The 0.97.2 report may be fully handled by the merged fix, or a remaining defect may depend on the exact monitor scaling, taskbar/work-area, or current release behavior; the available evidence cannot distinguish these outcomes.
issue_context.analysis: The historical evidence is strong enough to avoid inventing a second fix plan: the repository already contains a merged change aimed at this display geometry class. The decisive next step is author-side validation on the latest stable build using the same monitor orientation and a short confirmation of whether overflow remains. If it reproduces, the exact current version and focused reproduction details will determine whether this is a regression or an uncovered geometry edge case.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all three discussion comments, including the reporter's monitor-layout attachment reference, automated triage, and collaborator /needinfo request.
Inspected cited issue 40498: it reports Quick Accent offset on differently shaped monitors and points to a targeted fix included in PR 46593.
Inspected cited issue 49489: it was closed after a mitigation for WinUI 3 selection-window resizing and repositioning.

Inspected merged PR 46593: its public description identifies raw-pixel versus DIP width errors, application-DPI versus monitor-DPI positioning errors, and the multi-monitor fixes now present in the Quick Accent code.

Checked the current public Quick Accent source: PowerAccent.Core.Tools.WindowsFunctions.GetActiveDisplay obtains monitor effective DPI, PowerAccent.GetDisplayCoordinates uses the monitor geometry, and MainWindow.SizeAndPosition caps the measured popup width before moving and resizing it.
Confirmed there is no current linked PR or assignee for issue 50752.

information_gaps.information: Whether the overflow still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys release, including the exact version tested.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether the already-merged Quick Accent display fix resolved the report or whether a current regression remains.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update PowerToys to the latest stable release, reproduce with the same two-monitor orientation, and reply with the exact version shown in PowerToys About and whether the candidate box still exceeds either display.

information_gaps.information: A short current-release reproduction sequence and which monitor is active when Quick Accent is invoked.
information_gaps.why_needed: If the issue remains, this distinguishes a general popup-width failure from a monitor-origin, orientation, or DPI-specific edge case.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After updating, reply with numbered steps, the active monitor for each test, each display's scale percentage, and the expected versus actual popup bounds; include a fresh screenshot only if the problem remains.
